company.description: Evidence is an open source, code-based alternative to drag-and-drop BI tools. Build polished data products with just SQL and markdown.

productsAndServices.description: A server-side query engine that executes SQL queries on large datasets with sub-second response times, supporting multiple data sources and enterprise security features.
productsAndServices.name: Evidence Query Engine

productsAndServices.description: User interfaces including AI chat, explore pivot tables, and SQL console that allow end users to interact with data through natural language, drill-downs, and ad-hoc queries.
productsAndServices.name: Self-Serve Analytics Interfaces

productsAndServices.description: Enterprise-grade security including row-level and page-level access control, single sign-on, directory sync, encryption, and audit logging to protect data and manage user permissions.

productsAndServices.description: An open source foundation for building data products using SQL and markdown, enabling community contributions and extensibility through plugins and custom data source adapters.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,080,000, or 94.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,968,563 to $12,572,311, a 4.24x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 42 (-8 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Rill Data, Metabase, Looker.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
